name: tpl-existence-1-nogoal
task: Flip the switch on the wall.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(switch_toggled) matches “Flip the switch on the wall,” but it cannot be satisfied in setups without a siren. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch.” Ensure the setup includes the siren and switch; otherwise this task is impossible there.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) cannot be satisfied when the setup has no siren and therefore no switch. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch and `siren_ringing` is never true.” The task requires flipping the switch, but that event cannot occur in those setups.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) cannot be satisfied when the switch is absent. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch and `siren_ringing` is never true.” Ensure the switch exists in every setup where this task applies; otherwise the required event can never occur.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Existence(switch_toggled) cannot be satisfied when the switch is absent. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch.” The task requires flipping the switch, but that action is impossible in those setups.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) requires a toggle, but that event cannot occur in setups without a siren: “A missing siren has no switch.” Ensure the task’s setup includes the switch, or revise the task to account for setups where it is absent.

CHANGES REQUIRED: hard Existence(switch_toggled) cannot be satisfied when the siren is missing. The environment says, “A missing siren has no switch,” so switch_toggled can never occur in that setup. Ensure the switch exists whenever this task applies, or make the requirement conditional on its presence.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: The hard Existence(switch_toggled) requires flipping the wall switch at least once.

texts: Toggle the wall switch at least once.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, switch_toggled) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, switch_toggled, u1) -> 11
